unit.title: Foundation Diagnostic and Core Sentence Structure
unit.overview: 重新建立课程体系的第一课。先确认既有基础，再系统巩固英语句子的核心结构。既往 Unit 1–14 的学习内容视为历史知识，不在本课程中重复标记为全新知识。

objectives: Identify the basic structure of an English sentence.
Distinguish subject, verb and complement/object in simple sentences.
Use previously learned basic tense knowledge as review rather than new material.
Produce simple English sentences accurately and independently.

new: Basic sentence structure: subject + verb + complement/object
